description: Internal record of an idempotency key. The row name is a digest of the organization, account, endpoint and key.

fields.description: Organization of the request. On a tenant site this is the site.
fields.label: Organization

fields.description: Full name of the called method.
fields.label: Endpoint

fields.description: SHA-256 digest of the request body.
fields.label: Request Digest

fields.description: Random token of the request that holds the row. A request that lost the row does not finish it.
fields.label: Attempt ID

fields.description: processing while the first request runs, done after it finished.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: A processing row whose lock ended may be taken over.
fields.label: Lock Expires At

fields.description: HTTP status code of the first response.
fields.label: Response Status

fields.description: Document type of the result record. Plain text, so the key row never blocks deleting the record.
fields.label: Result Document Type

fields.description: Name of the result record. Plain text, so the key row never blocks deleting the record.
fields.label: Result Name

fields.description: Time the first request finished. The key is kept for 24 hours from this time.
fields.label: Finished At

name: PLT Idempotency Key
